title: Otto J NDE 7388
content: It was a dark overcast day in a small town. I was sitting on a sofa on the back porch of an old house watching the rain. It was really pouring down. My girlfriend had just broken up with me and I decided I'd had enough of life. Three of my brothers were killed in accidents and I wanted to know were they went, as I loved them and had no feelings for anyone else in this life except my girlfriend. She wasn't someone who would reciprocate love. She was young too and just wanted to have fun. I took some drugs and drank a small bottle of strong whiskey. I lay down and decided to stop breathing. There was no reflex action to breath again, I just sunk deeper and deeper into unconsciousness. To my surprise, I was again watching the rain but it was hitting the ground in slow motion. There was plenty of time to watch each individual drop, even though it was raining even harder now. Then everything went white, like a bright mist. The mist cleared as I moved forward. There was no sensation of walking. I just wanted to move forward and that's where I went. As the mist cleared, I looked down. There was a line or boundary that I knew I wasn't to cross. Beyond the line, there was a very large, plain building with an opening like an arch at its base. People were coming through the mist and passing through the opening as if it was the normal thing to do. As I pondered this situation, a women in her 50's came up behind me and put her hand on my shoulder. She said, "You know you're not suppose to be here, aye?" I got the impression she could tell I wasn't in a good state of mind and I knew I wasn't going to get any further than this. Just as I was turning back I woke up. I don't know how she found me but the girlfriend I mentioned was dragging me across the floor screaming "wake up!" I vomited and began breathing. She said I was blue. There wasn't anything good about the experience. I just felt more confused.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Everything went white, like a bright mist; the mist cleared as I moved forward.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: No sensation of walking; moved forward by wanting to move forward.

arrival.other_being_detail: A woman in her 50's came up behind me, put her hand on my shoulder, and spoke to me.

environment.environment_other_detail: A line/boundary not to cross; beyond it a very large, plain building with an arch-like opening at its base; people coming through the mist and passing through the opening.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Intentional drug and alcohol ingestion and decided to stop breathing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived rain in slow motion before everything went white like a bright mist.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Altered time perception while still observing the rain, then white mist/forward movement, then boundary/building/people, then encounter with a woman and immediate return on waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Rain observed in slow motion before the white mist; a clear line/boundary not to cross while others passed through an arch-like opening in a large plain building.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "You know you're not suppose to be here, aye?"; "There wasn't anything good about the experience. I just felt more confused."
